description: When active, this bionic shoots out electricity wildly. Can be useful in certain situations.
When active, this bionic shoots out electricity wildly. Can be useful in certain situations.
When this bionic is active, you can burn nearly any organic material as fuel (use 'E'), recharging your power level. Some materials will burn better than others.
When installed in your chest is an arc reactor that produces a large amount of power, forever! Welcome to alien tech.

A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 500 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 750 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 2000 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

Concealed in your arm is a rifle chambered in .556. The rifle has no brand or anything, but does have a really cool HUD red dot to aid in shooting and goes away when your not aiming. Has a small hopper on the top to quickload loose rounds easily. Activate the bionic to fire and reload the arm rifle.
A military nanoforge capable of manufacturing ammunition from stored materials.
